'''William Robert''' "'''Billy Bob'''" '''Thompson''' is an American voice actor for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Thompson was born as William Robert Thompson sometime on January 22 in Vermont, and became a voice actor as an adult. He joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|BW}}, specifically [[S14|its fourteenth season]]. His most prominent role during that time was [[Burgh]]. Thompson then crossed over into the {{aniseries|XY|''XY'' series}}, where he gained the notable roles of [[Ash's Greninja|Ash's Froakie, Frogadier, and Greninja]]; as well as [[Squishy]], [[Z2]], and [[Clemont's Luxray]]. Most recently, Thompson voiced the {{tc|Team Skull Grunt}} [[Tupp]] during the {{aniseries|SM|''Sun & Moon'' series}}.
